prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: All imported goods must pass through _____ before they can be sold in the domestic market.
options: customs
costumes
customers
customs duty free of

wrong.costumes: costumes 是「服裝」，與進口通關無關，只是拼字像。
wrong.customers: customers 是「顧客」，貨物不是通過顧客。
wrong.customs duty free of: 這不是完整名詞，語法不通，而且 free of 的位置不對。

why: 貨物進口必須經過海關，customs 在這裡是「海關」，通常用複數形。
tip: customs（海關）和 costume（服裝）不要混淆。
say: All imported goods must pass through customs before they can be sold in the domestic market.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The shipment was delayed because the required export _____ had not been approved.
options: license
lesson
legend
liquid

wrong.lesson: lesson 是「課程」，不是出口所需的文件。
wrong.legend: legend 是「傳說」，與審核批准的文件無關。
wrong.liquid: liquid 是「液體」，不能當 export 的名詞。

why: approved 提示是需要核准的文件，export license 是出口許可證。
say: The shipment was delayed because the required export license had not been approved.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的商務英文？
options: The goods will be shipped by sea next Monday.
The goods will ship by sea at next Monday.
The goods will be shipped with sea on next Monday.
The goods will be shipping by sea next Monday.
answer: The goods will be shipped by sea next Monday.

wrong.The goods will ship by sea at next Monda: 貨物是被運送，要用被動 be shipped；next Monday 前面不用 at。
wrong.The goods will be shipped with sea on ne: 海運用 by sea，不是 with sea；next Monday 前不加 on。
wrong.The goods will be shipping by sea next M: 貨物不會自己運送，要用被動式 shipped。

why: 貨物是被運出，用 will be shipped；交通方式用 by。
tip: 運輸方式用 by：by sea、by air。
say: The goods will be shipped by sea next Monday.

prompt: 客戶問為什麼貨還沒到，你要回答：「船因為天氣延誤了。」哪一句最合適？
options: The vessel was delayed because of bad weather.
The vessel delayed because bad weather.
The vessel was delaying because of the bad weather.
The vessel was delayed because bad weather happened it.
answer: The vessel was delayed because of bad weather.

delay 在此要用被動 was delayed；because 後面接名詞時要用 because of。
wrong.The vessel was delaying because of the b: was delaying 是進行式，意思是船在延誤別人，應該用被動。
wrong.The vessel was delayed because bad weath: happen 是不及物動詞，不能接 it 當受詞，句子也過於複雜且不自然。

why: 船被延誤用被動式；because of 後接名詞片語。
tip: because of + 名詞；because + 子句。
say: The vessel was delayed because of bad weather.

text: Import duties are charged on the value of the goods, not on their weight.
options: 進口關稅按貨物價值計算，不按重量計算。
進口關稅按貨物重量計算，不看價值。
進口貨物免收任何關稅。
進口關稅由運送貨物的司機自行支付。
answer: 進口關稅按貨物價值計算，不按重量計算。

wrong.進口關稅按貨物重量計算，不看價值。: not on their weight 表示不按重量，這個選項剛好顛倒。
wrong.進口貨物免收任何關稅。: 原句說 duties are charged，表示有收關稅。
wrong.進口關稅由運送貨物的司機自行支付。: 原句沒有說由誰支付，只說明計算依據。

why: on the value ... not on their weight 對比了計算依據。
tip: not A but B 或 B, not A：強調 B。
say: Import duties are charged on the value of the goods, not on their weight.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: Exporters should check the destination country's _____ before shipping electronic products.
options: regulations
registrations
reflections
relations

wrong.registrations: registrations 是「登記、註冊」，不是各國對進口商品的規定。
wrong.reflections: reflections 是「反射、反思」，與出口規範無關。
wrong.relations: relations 是「關係」，無法說明貨物能不能出口。

why: 出口前要先查目的地國家的法規，regulations 是規定。
say: Exporters should check the destination country's regulations before shipping electronic products.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的商務英文？
options: The company imports most of its raw materials from abroad.
The company import most of its raw materials from abroad.
The company imports most of it raw materials from abroad.
The company imports the most of its raw materials from abroad.
answer: The company imports most of its raw materials from abroad.

wrong.The company import most of its raw mater: company 是單數主詞，動詞要用 imports。
wrong.The company imports most of it raw mater: 所有格要用 its，不是代名詞 it。
wrong.The company imports the most of its raw: most of 表示大部分，前面不能加 the。

why: 單數主詞用 imports；its 是所有格；most of 不加 the。
tip: its 是所有格，it's 是 it is。
say: The company imports most of its raw materials from abroad.
